description: a tall reaper lord in a deep black hood of smoke, the face hidden behind a silver mask shaped like a skull with glowing crimson eyes, black armour with white bone plates shaped like ribs on the chest, spiked bone pauldrons, a dark belt, a long tattered black cloak hanging behind from the shoulders, black boots with pale bone knee guards, no spirit lights, no ghosts, no scythes and nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and the mask pointing right, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the hood to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same character seen from the side: skull mask, smoke hood, bone armour, cloak, colours and drawing style; not the sitting pose and not the hands on the reins: he stands and walks
the character's look in detail: skull mask, smoke hood, bone armour, cloak and colours; the hands empty, without the two scythes, the ghosts and the spirit lights
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen exactly from the side in profile, facing right, upright mid-step, not turned towards the viewer; copy it exactly
